enabled.label: query
enabled.description: Whether to enable or disable tracing
Whether tracing is enabled (only present when a backlog tracer is available)

traces.description: The traced messages, as opaque JSON objects (only present when dumping)

standby.description: Whether the tracer is in standby mode (only present when not dumping)

counter.description: Total number of traced messages (only present when not dumping)

backlogSize.description: The current backlog size (only present when not dumping)

queueSize.description: The current queue size (only present when not dumping)

removeOnDump.description: Whether messages are removed from the backlog when dumped (only present when not dumping)

traceFilter.description: The trace filter (only present when configured)

tracePattern.description: The trace pattern (only present when configured)

traceRests.description: Whether rests are traced (only present when not dumping)

traceTemplates.description: Whether route templates/Kamelets are traced (only present when not dumping)

bodyMaxChars.description: Maximum size of the message body to include (only present when not dumping)

bodyIncludeFiles.description: Whether file-based message bodies are included (only present when not dumping)

bodyIncludeStreams.description: Whether streaming message bodies are included (only present when not dumping)

includeExchangeProperties.description: Whether exchange properties are included (only present when not dumping)

includeExchangeVariables.description: Whether exchange variables are included (only present when not dumping)

includeException.description: Whether exceptions are included (only present when not dumping)
